policy_text: Students must submit financial aid applications before the published deadline. Late applications may require manual review.
Students must complete registration changes before the published registration deadline. Exceptions require approval from the appropriate academic administrator.
Technology support requests should include the affected service, device information, and a description of the problem. Critical service outages must be escalated to IT support.
Accessibility accommodation requests should be handled through the accessibility support process. Sensitive accommodation information should only be shared with authorized staff.
Academic support requests should be routed to the responsible support team and answered using current, approved institutional policy information.
